query: Which economic and productivity measures (lead-time decomposition, change-failure rate, time-on-security) are most sensitive to REFA trade-offs and how should they be instrumented?

response.query: Which economic and productivity measures (lead-time decomposition, change-failure rate, time-on-security) are most sensitive to REFA trade-offs and how should they be instrumented?
response.answer: Lead-time decomposition and change-failure rate are most sensitive to REFA trade-offs; they should be instrumented with precise timing and failure tracking metrics. Time-on-security is less sensitive but still requires accurate monitoring.
